note: Every business case in the City of Calgary's "2027-2030 budget request business cases": number, title, department, business unit, the amounts and staff proposed, the City's own categories, and the page of the City's document. Proposed to Council on November 10, 2026; not approved. Read by tools/budget_intel_extract.py; names are as the City prints them.
status: Proposed by Administration; before Council. Nothing here is approved until Council votes on the 2027–2030 budget.

units.cap_k: thousands of dollars: total, 2027, 2028, 2029, 2030, 2031 and later (the City's "4-Year Capital Budget Consideration")

units.split: per cent: maintenance or replacement, growth, service enhancement, transformative
units.null: a dash in the City's table (nil)
